/cuts/#0/text: The only smithy in a mountain village… so few customers, it's about to go bust!
/cuts/#1/text: Then a boy kicks the door open. 'I'll dig up good stuff! Just make me a good sword!'
/cuts/#2/text: The smith grips the dusty hammer once more. '…Heh, I like that look in your eye.'
/cuts/#3/text: Deal! I make the swords, you dig up the goods! And so our smithy's comeback began!
